description: Enhanced date-serial coverage around the historical leap-year boundary and both epochs: the day before and after the spurious 1900 leap day (1900-02-28, 1900-03-01), the 1904 epoch anchor, a real leap day (2000-02-29), and the day before the default epoch (1899-12-31). Exercised under both the 1900 and 1904 conventions.
